name: tapezero
description: TAPEZERO — Rewind live Solana launches. Inspect the swaps behind every move.

scripts.trailer:render: node scripts/score.ts trailer && remotion render film/index.ts Trailer public/film/trailer.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=23 --audio-codec=aac --pixel-format=yuv420p --gl=angle && remotion still film/index.ts Trailer public/film/trailer-poster.jpg --frame=225 --image-format=jpeg --jpeg-quality=85 --gl=angle
scripts.promo:render: node scripts/score.ts promo && remotion render film/index.ts Promo public/film/tapezero-x-launch.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=18 --audio-codec=aac --audio-bitrate=192k --pixel-format=yuv420p --gl=angle
